naming_principles: Burmese object-before-verb action names and function-based noun groups. Addresses are locations, not email; sending is a transport operation. Standard proper names and character fixtures retain their identities.
etymology_review: Modern functional proposals. No historical attestation is claimed for compounds.

rationale.주소: Replace the unrelated email sense with the general location/address noun.
rationale.보내기: Use the general send verb rather than an email-specific command.
rationale.실행영상: An executable memory image is code, not a photograph.
rationale.쌓임공간: The stack stores nested execution data; it is not a peer-group subdivision.
rationale.국가실행기: A country-edition launcher starts the configured system; it is not a country-language selector.
rationale.port: A network or hardware port is a communication access point, not a harbour. Porting software is a separate role.
rationale.register: Processor registers are fast storage cells. Registering handlers is a distinct enrollment action, with explicit whole-role names.
